title: audit-horizon-core: verification code for "Self-audit horizons of finitely axiomatized theories"
description:
Verification code for the paper Self-audit horizons of finitely axiomatized theories: non-accumulation of finite reflection and the cost of external verification (H. Sendo).

The code reproduces every numerical result of the paper: exact counts of formulas and the singularity analysis for first-order languages L(c,k,m) (trichotomy, bases b = 1+√2, 3, 1+2√2, exponents γ = 3/2 and 5/4, asymptotic constants in closed form), a linear-time saturation audit for fragments of Robinson's Q with the operation bounds of Lemma 5.1, and an exhaustive check that {Q1, Q2} has no small finite model. python3 scripts/reproduce_all.py compares each value with the value printed in the paper. Python 3.8 or later, no third-party packages.
notes: Reproduces the numerical results of the accompanying paper (MSC 2020: 03F20, 03F30, 03F40, 05A16). The paper is not included in this record.
